auth-form.ifThatAddressCanSignIn: If that address can sign in with a code, one is on its way. It works for 5 minutes, once, in this browser.
auth-form.lostTheAppABackupCode: Lost the app? A backup code works once.
auth-form.lowercaseHyphensAllowedThisNamesYour: Lowercase, hyphens allowed. This names your {@workspace.one} URLs.
auth-form.lowercaseLettersDigitsAndSingleHyphens: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens — like a good directory name

cli-authorize-authorize.aTerminalRanFoldrunLoginAnd: A terminal ran foldrun login and is waiting for you to say it is yours.
cli-authorize-authorize.adminAKeyIsNeverAn: admin (a key is never an owner)
cli-authorize-authorize.approvingCreatesAnApiKeyFor: Approving creates an API key for that machine at your role. The machine name is whatever that terminal said — it proves nothing. Approve only if you ran foldrun login yourself just now and your own terminal shows this code. If someone sent you this link, deny it.
cli-authorize-authorize.noSignInRequestHasThat: No sign-in request has that code. It may have expired — run foldrun login again.
cli-authorize-authorize.theKeyItHoldsIsOn: The key it holds is on Settings → API keys, labelled with the machine. Revoke it there to sign that machine out.
cli-authorize-authorize.theTerminalWasToldNoNothing: The terminal was told no. Nothing was created.
cli-authorize-authorize.thisRequestCameFromADifferent: This request came from a different network than the one this browser is on. If you did not just run foldrun login on another machine of your own, deny it.
cli-authorize-authorize.yourTerminalOnIsSignedIn: Your terminal on {hostname} is signed in as {email}. You can close this tab.
cli-authorize-authorize.modelAccessLabel: Also let it call foldrun's models
cli-authorize-authorize.modelAccessTerms: The same key pays for model calls on this machine (foldrun code, the API's /v1/messages): your plan first, then at most ${walletUsd} of bought credits over the key's life, and never more than ${dailyUsd} a day in all. Untick it for a key that only reaches the platform.
cli-authorize-authorize.modelAccessNotOffered: This sign-in will not call foldrun's models: only an admin of every {@workspace.one} can let a key spend the account's balance.

forgot-page.enterYourEmailAndWeWill: Enter your email and we will send a link that works once, for 30 minutes.

login-page.yourAgentsKeptWorkingSeeWhat: Your agents kept working. See what they did.

mcp-authorize-authorize.allOfThemAndNewOnes: All of them, and new ones
mcp-authorize-authorize.andIfYouAllowItTo: , and — if you allow it — to start and stop runs, approve gates, answer agents, and create {@workspace.other} and change their files
mcp-authorize-authorize.itAsksToUseFoldrunAccount: It asks to use foldrun account {account} as
mcp-authorize-authorize.itCanNeverDoMoreThan: It can never do more than you can. Settings → API keys → Connected AI apps lists it; revoke it there at any time.
mcp-authorize-authorize.readAndActAlsoStartStop2: <radioGroupItem></radioGroupItem> Read and act — also start, stop, approve, answer, message, and edit {@workspace.other}
mcp-authorize-authorize.readOnlyInboxRunsFlowsFiles: <radioGroupItem></radioGroupItem> Read only — inbox, runs, flows, files
mcp-authorize-authorize.thatIsAnAppOnThis: That is an app on this computer. Approve only if you just started it yourself.
mcp-authorize-authorize.thisSignInRequestCannotBe: this sign-in request cannot be used
mcp-authorize-authorize.yourInboxRunsFlowsAndFiles: ({role}): your inbox, runs, flows and files{part}.

reset-page.atLeast10CharactersEveryOther: At least 10 characters. Every other session of yours will be signed out.
reset-page.thisLinkIsMissingItsToken: This link is missing its token — open it from the email.

signup-page.aFolderOfMarkdownRunningOn: A folder of markdown, running on a schedule, by tonight.
signup-page.contactToAskForAnAccount: Contact <email></email> to ask for an account. If a teammate invited you, open the link they sent.
signup-page.forChooseAnAccountNameAnd: For <email></email>. Choose an account name and a password.
signup-page.isAlreadySignedUpSignIn: <email></email> is already signed up. Sign in with it instead.
signup-page.itHasExpiredOrIsNot: It has expired or is not complete. Ask for a new one where you got it — a link works for seven days.
signup-page.signUpWithTheInviteIs: Sign up with <email></email> — the invite is for that address, and works once.
signup-page.thatInviteIsNoLongerValid: That invite is no longer valid
signup-page.thatSignUpLinkIsNo: That sign-up link is no longer valid
signup-page.thisAddressAlreadyHasAnAccount: This address already has an account
signup-page.thisInstallDoesnSYoursStart: This install doesn't accept new accounts — ask whoever runs it for an invite. If it's yours, start the server with FOLDRUN_OPEN_SIGNUP=1.
signup-page.thisInstallSEnvAsFoldrun: This install's first account is created from the link the installer printed (/signup?setup=…). It is also in the install's .env as FOLDRUN_SETUP_TOKEN.
signup-page.usedRevokedOrExpiredAskYour: Used, revoked or expired — ask your teammate for a fresh link. An invite works once, for seven days.
signup-page.youWereInvitedAsWithAccess: You were invited as {role}, with access to {part}.

unsubscribe-page.changedYourMindTurnItBack: Changed your mind? Turn it back on under <link>Profile → Notifications</link>.
unsubscribe-page.itIsIncompleteOrWasNot: It is incomplete or was not made by this install. Open it from the email again, or sign in and change what you receive under Profile → Notifications.
unsubscribe-page.willGetNoMoreEverythingElse: {email} will get no more {what}. Everything else you receive is unchanged — and mail about security, invites and failed payments is always sent.
